svg.title: Figure 7-1: response budget per stop function
svg.desc: Eight horizontal bars on one time axis from zero to three hundred milliseconds, one per stop function, each made of a grey input segment, a teal logic segment and an amber power-removal segment with the milliseconds written in, a red target tick per bar, and a hatched tail for the unmeasured standstill; every bar ends before its tick except the loss-of-command function, which overshoots by the relay time.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure 7-1 Demand-to-power-removal budget per stop function, against its target

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three segments per function: the detecting device or input window, the logic (speed monitor and safety relay), the power removal (contactors). The red tick is the target of §7. The hatched bar is the standstill, unmeasured.
